camel_example: aliyun winnexo POST /openapi/searchAliDingGroupChats --region cn-hangzhou --tenantId 10000 --header "Content-Type=application/x-www-form-urlencoded" --body cursor=0&excludeMuted=false&pageSize=20&keyword=客户项目 --version 2026-05-12 --force
description_en: Searches for DingTalk group chats in the Winnexo lightweight workspace
description_zh: Winnexo 轻量工作台搜索阿里钉群聊
name: SearchAliDingGroupChats

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. This is a common parameter. If this parameter is not specified, the default tenant of the caller is used
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，公共参数，缺省时使用调用方默认租户
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The keyword for search. The keyword always matches the name field. If the description field is defined in the schema, the keyword also matches the description field
parameters.help_zh: 关键字搜索（固定匹配 name；若 schema 定义 description，则同时匹配 description）
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en: The cursor for the paged query. Set this parameter to 0 for the first request. For subsequent paging requests, set this parameter to the value of nextCursor returned in the previous response
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询的游标，最开始传0，后续传返回参数中的nextCursor值
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to exclude muted group chats
parameters.name: exclude_muted

200.description_en: Winnexo 轻量工作台按关键词搜索阿里钉群聊
200.description_zh: Winnexo 轻量工作台按关键词搜索阿里钉群聊

schema.description_en: The response for searching for DingTalk group chats by keyword in the Winnexo lightweight workspace
schema.description_zh: Winnexo 轻量工作台按关键词搜索阿里钉群聊

hasMore.description_en: Indicates whether more pages are available

items.description_en: The user group tree node information

chatId.description_en: The conversation ID. This ID is typically used for JSSDK

conversationType.description_en:
The conversation type. Valid values:
0: one-on-one chat.
1: group chat.

For a one-on-one chat, you do not need to specify openConversationId. Specify the employee ID in receiverUserIdList. For a one-on-one chat between two users, specify the employee ID of either user. For a one-on-one chat between a user and a bot, specify the employee ID of the user
conversationType.description_zh:
发送的会话类型：
0：单聊
1：群聊

单聊时，openConversationId不用填写，receiverUserIdList填写员工号（两个用户之间的单聊填写双方中任一员工号， 用户与机器人之间的单聊填写用户员工号）

muted.description_en: Indicates whether the current user has enabled the Do Not Disturb mode
muted.description_zh: 当前用户是否开启免打扰

title.description_en: The title of the scheduled meeting

message.description_en: The description of the status code

nextCursor.description_en: The starting cursor for the next page
